data.body: **[P2] Select retry control flow when continuation dispatch itself fails fatally.** If `coordinator.execute` throws `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` before running the task, this path only releases the lease and rethrows. `WaitForConditionOperation` invokes it from an ignored `thenCompose` chain, so the error is captured by `CompletableFuture` and lease release can incorrectly select `PENDING`. Call `signalContinuationFatal` before releasing the registration, and add a coordinator-dispatch fatal regression test.
